description: Official NYSE/ICE published full-day cash-equity closures and 13:00 New York early closes, 2019-2025 inclusive, for the intraday comparison. Every date comes from an official NYSE Group press release on ir.theice.com (the scheduled multi-year holiday and early-closing calendars) or, for the 2025-01-09 National Day of Mourning, the NYSE exceptional-closure announcement. Dates were not inferred from recurring holiday rules, bond-market hours, or OHLC completeness. Early closes are 13:00 America/New_York cash-equity session closes (1:15 p.m. for eligible options only; not represented here). A year is listed only if its schedule was verified against the official publications below.

sources.note: Scheduled 2019 calendar. Full closures in the HOLIDAY table; early closes at 1:00 p.m. are the July 3, November 29, and December 24 footnotes.

2019.coverage_notes: Verified from the official 2019/2020/2021 NYSE calendar press release. 2019-12-24 (Christmas Eve) was an early close, not a closure; 2019-12-25 (Christmas) was a full closure. Independence Day fell on Thursday, so 2019-07-03 (Wednesday) was the early close before it.

sources.note: Independent re-announcement of the 2020 calendar; confirms all dates.

2020.coverage_notes: 2020-07-03 was a full closure (Independence Day observed; July 4 fell Saturday), so there is no July 2020 early close. Early closes are November 27 (day after Thanksgiving) and December 24 (Christmas Eve). Confirmed by two official press releases.

sources.note: Independent re-announcement of the 2021 calendar; confirms all dates.

2021.coverage_notes: 2021-07-05 was a full closure (Independence Day observed; July 4 fell Sunday) and 2021-12-24 was a full closure (Christmas observed; December 25 fell Saturday), so there is no Christmas Eve early close. The only early close is November 26 (day after Thanksgiving).

sources.note: Independent re-announcement of the 2022 calendar; confirms all dates and the no-holiday note for New Year's Day.
Official NYSE calendar page captured 2022-12-23; lists only 2022-11-25 as the 2022 early close, confirming there was no December 2022 early close.

2022.coverage_notes: No New Year's Day closure (January 1 fell Saturday; no holiday observed pursuant to NYSE Rule 7.2, per the official release). 2022-06-20 was the observed Juneteenth (June 19 fell Sunday). Christmas observed on 2022-12-26 (December 25 fell Sunday); Christmas Eve fell on Saturday so there was no December 2022 early close, confirmed by the NYSE calendar page captured 2022-12-23.

sources.note: Independent re-announcement of the 2023 calendar; confirms all dates.
Official NYSE calendar page captured 2023-12-23; lists 2023-07-03 and 2023-11-24 as the 2023 early closes, confirming there was no December 2023 early close.

2023.coverage_notes: 2023-01-02 was the observed New Year's Day (January 1 fell Sunday). Early closes are July 3 (before Independence Day) and November 24 (day after Thanksgiving). Christmas Eve fell on Sunday, so there was no December 2023 early close, confirmed by the NYSE calendar page captured 2023-12-23.

sources.note: Independent re-announcement of the 2024 calendar; confirms all dates.

2024.coverage_notes: Early closes are July 3 (before Independence Day), November 29 (day after Thanksgiving), and December 24 (Christmas Eve). No observed-holiday shifts needed in 2024; all holidays fell on their nominal dates.

sources.note: Independent re-announcement of the 2025 calendar; confirms all scheduled dates.
Exceptional closure: NYSE Group will close all equity and options markets on 2025-01-09 for the National Day of Mourning for former President Jimmy Carter. Primary source for the 2025-01-09 closure.

2025.coverage_notes: 2025-01-09 (Thursday) is the National Day of Mourning exceptional closure, announced 2024-12-30 by the NYSE and carried as its own source above; it is not part of the scheduled calendar. All other closures are the announced 2025 schedule. Early closes are July 3, November 28 (day after Thanksgiving), and December 24 (Christmas Eve).
